extName.message: Markpilot — Web Notes to Obsidian & AI

extDesc.message: Highlight notes → local Obsidian → LLM Q&A in context, with long-term memory

sendFailedHint.message: Failed to send. Click the toolbar icon to open the side panel

selQuotePrefix.description: Quote prefix, $1 is the selected text

newChatTitle.message: Clear current conversation and start a new one

chatPlaceholder.message: Ask anything… (page content + your notes + selection included)

noNotesYet.message: No notes on this page yet — select some text to add one

exportAuthFailed.message:
Authorization/export failed: $1
(you can fall back to the obsidian:// URI)

starter1.message: Summarize the key points of this article

starter2.message: List and explain terms I might not understand

starter3.message: Point out possible misunderstandings in my notes

starter4.message: Explain this page to me with the Feynman method

chatWelcome.message: Ask anything — page content, your notes, and selection are included

streamingWait.message: Streaming — stop it or wait for completion

rememberTitle.message: Save this conclusion as long-term memory

memBadgeTitle.message: Click to review and save auto-discovered memories

followupExpand.description: $1 is a heading from the answer

followupCode.message: Explain the code above line by line

followupConflict.message: Does this conflict with my notes?

confirmNewChat.message: Clear this conversation? Saved notes are not affected.

askAboutSelection.description: Auto question from page Ask AI, $1 is the selected text

labelBaseUrl.message: Base URL (leave empty for provider preset; fill for custom proxy/vLLM)

modelPh.message: Type to filter, or click "Fetch models"

openrouterHint.message: OpenRouter lists models without a key; free models are marked ⭐.

labelApiKey.message: API Key (stored only in local IndexedDB, never uploaded)

keyWarn.message: Keys stay in this browser. The Anthropic direct-browser-access header is added automatically.

labelSystemPrompt.message: System prompt for Q&A (clear it to send no system message)

systemPromptHint.message: Page content, notes and selection are always sent; this only controls the persona.

labelMemoryInject.message: Inject relevant memories when asking (default on)

labelAutoMemory.message: Auto-extract memory candidates (default off; badge for your confirmation)

vaultNeedPrompt.message: Folder selected — click once to restore permission

modelsFetchedTail.message: — click the model input to pick one.

modelEmptyList.message: No list yet — click "Fetch models" or type manually

testOk.description: $1 is the model name, $2 is seconds

testEmpty.message: ⚠ $1 connected but returned nothing — try another

testTimeout.message: ✗ $1 no response in 30s (upstream may be down — try another)

testFailed.description: $1 is the model name, $2 is the error detail

modelNotConfiguredError.message: No model configured — set it in the settings page

extractFailed.message: Couldn't extract page text — this page may have been opened before the extension was installed or updated. Refresh the page and try again (restricted pages like chrome:// are unsupported).
